harrat-mujtaba:1-1.t: The wāw is a particle of oath and of the genitive; «القرآن» is the thing sworn by, and the preposition [phrase] is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the implied verb «أقسم» ("I swear"). «ذي»: naʿt (adjective) of «القرآن». The answer to the oath is implied, i.e.: you are indeed among the messengers.

harrat-mujtaba:2-2.t: (بل الذين كفروا في عزة وشقاق) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The clause is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:3-3.t: «كم» is predicative (khabariyya), mafʿūl bihi (direct object). The preposition «من قرن» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «كم». The clause «فنادوا» is conjoined to the clause «أهلكنا». «لات» is a negating particle acting like «ليس»; its noun, «الحين», is omitted, and «حينَ» is its khabar (predicate); the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial).

harrat-mujtaba:4-4.t: «أن» is maṣdar-forming, and the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) is accusative by removal of the preposition (من), i.e.: and they wondered at the coming. The clause «وعجبوا» is conjoined to the clause «نادوا». The clause «جاءهم» is the ṣila (relative clause) of the particle relative (al-mawṣūl al-ḥarfī). The clause «وقال الكافرون» is conjoined to the clause «عجبوا».

harrat-mujtaba:5-5.t: The clause «أجعل» is resumptive within the scope of the speech; «إلها» is a second object. The clause «إن هذا لشيء» is resumptive within the scope of the speech, and the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa).

harrat-mujtaba:6-6.t: The clause «وانطلق الملأ» is conjoined to the clause «قال» in verse (4). The preposition «منهم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «الملأ». «أن» is explicative (mufassira), and the clause after it is explicative; what is meant by "setting off" is the setting off of their tongues with this speech. The clause «إن هذا لشيء» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:7-7.t: The clause «ما سمعنا» is resumptive, and likewise the clause «إن هذا ...»; «إنْ» is the negating one, and «إلا» is for restriction.

harrat-mujtaba:8-8.t: The preposition «من بيننا» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the hāʾ in «عليه». The clause «بل هم في شك» is resumptive. The preposition «من ذكري» is attached to a naʿt (adjective) of «شك». «لما» is jussive-making; «عذاب» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative with an implied (muqaddar) fatḥa on the letter before the omitted yāʾ. The clause «لما يذوقوا» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:9-9.t: «العزيز الوهاب»: two naʿts (adjectives). «أم» is the disjoined (munqaṭiʿa) one, meaning «بل» plus the hamza.

harrat-mujtaba:10-10.t: «أم» is the disjoined (munqaṭiʿa) one. «ما»: a relative noun conjoined to «السماوات». The adverb «بينهما» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the ṣila (relative clause). The clause «فليرتقوا» is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied condition, i.e.: if they claim that, then let them ascend; the lām is the jussive-making lām of command.

harrat-mujtaba:11-11.t: «جند»: khabar (predicate) of a concealed mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e.: they are a host. «ما» is added (redundant). «هنالك»: a demonstrative, an adverb of place attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «جند». «مهزوم»: a second naʿt of «جند». The preposition «من الأحزاب» is attached to a third naʿt of «جند».

harrat-mujtaba:14-14.t: «إنْ» is negating, «كل» is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause «كذَّب» is the khabar (predicate). The clause «فحق عقاب» is conjoined to the clause «كذَّب»; «عقاب» is the fāʿil (agent), nominative with an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the letter before the omitted yāʾ.

harrat-mujtaba:15-15.t: The clause «وما ينظر هؤلاء» is conjoined to the clause {إِنْ كُلٌّ إِلا كَذَّبَ}. «صيحة»: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). The clause «ما لها من فواق» is a second naʿt (adjective) of «صيحة»; «فواق» is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and «من» is redundant (zāʾida).

harrat-mujtaba:16-16.t: The clause «وقالوا» is resumptive. «ربنا»: the one addressed, in a construct (munādā muḍāf), accusative. «قبل»: an adverb of time attached to (mutaʿalliq) «عجّل».

harrat-mujtaba:17-17.t: «ما» is maṣdar-forming. «داود»: badal (substitute). «ذا»: naʿt (adjective), interpreted as a derived word. The clause «إنه أواب» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «داود».

harrat-mujtaba:18-18.t: The clause «إنَّا سخَّرنا» is resumptive. The clause «يسبِّحن» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «الجبال». His words «معه»: an adverb of place attached to (mutaʿalliq) «يسبحن», and likewise «بالعشي».

harrat-mujtaba:19-19.t: His words «والطير محشورة» conjoin an accusative object to an accusative object, and a ḥāl (circumstantial) to a ḥāl; but the second ḥāl is a noun, to indicate that their gathering was all at once, which points more strongly to [Allah's] power. The clause «كل له أواب» is a ḥāl from «الجبال والطير»; beginning with an indefinite noun is permitted because it denotes generality. The preposition «له» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «أواب».

harrat-mujtaba:20-20.t: The clause «وشددنا» is conjoined to the clause {سَخَّرْنَا}; «الحكمة» is a second object.

harrat-mujtaba:21-21.t: The interrogative clause is resumptive. «إذ»: an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) «أتاك».

harrat-mujtaba:22-22.t: «إذ»: an adverbial noun, badal (substitute) of the preceding «إذ», and the clause «دخلوا» is muḍāf ilayhi (in genitive construct). The clause «ففزع» is conjoined to the clause «دخلوا». The clause «قالوا» is resumptive. «خصمان»: khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being: we are two disputants; the clause is resumptive within the scope of the speech. The clause «بغى بعضنا» is a naʿt (adjective) of «خصمان». The clause «فاحكم» is conjoined to the clause «بغى». The preposition «بالحق» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil (agent) of «احكم».

harrat-mujtaba:23-23.t: The clause «إن هذا أخي» is resumptive. The clause «له تسع» is a second khabar (predicate) of «إن». «نعجة»: tamyīz (specification). The clause «فقال» is resumptive, and the yāʾ and the hāʾ are two objects. The clause «عَزَّنِي» is conjoined to the clause «قال».

harrat-mujtaba:24-24.t: The preposition «إلى نعاجه» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the maṣdar (verbal noun) (سؤال), which is made to carry (mudammin) the sense of joining, i.e.: he wronged you by joining your ewe so that it is [added] to his ewes; for that reason it is made transitive with «إلى». The clause «وإن كثيرا ...» is conjoined to the content of what is said (maqūl al-qawl). The preposition «من الخلطاء» is attached to a naʿt (adjective) of «كثيرا», and the preposition «على بعض» is attached to «يبغي». «الذين»: excepted. The wāw in «وقليل» is parenthetical; «قليل» is a khabar (predicate) placed first, «هم» is the mubtadaʾ (subject), and «ما» is redundant (zāʾida); the clause is parenthetical between the two conjoined [clauses], because the clause «وظنَّ داود» is conjoined to the clause «قال». «أنَّ» and what follows it are interpreted as a maṣdar that takes the place of the two objects of «ظن». The clause «فاستغفر» is conjoined to the clause «ظن». «راكعا»: ḥāl (circumstantial).

harrat-mujtaba:25-25.t: The clause «فغفرنا» is conjoined to the clause «استغفر». The clause «وإن له عندنا ...» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the pronoun «نا» in «غفرنا»; the lām is for emphasis. The adverb «عندنا» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the [notion of] being established (al-istiqrār) to which the khabar (predicate) is attached.

harrat-mujtaba:26-26.t: «خليفة»: second object; the preposition «في الأرض» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «خليفة». The clause «فاحكم» is conjoined to the clause «جعلناك», and the preposition «بالحق» is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil (agent) of «فاحكم». The fāʾ in «فيضلك» is causal (sababiyya), and the verb is accusative by an implied «أن»; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) is conjoined to a maṣdar extracted from the preceding speech, i.e.: let there be no following [of desire], and so [no] leading astray. The clause «لهم عذاب» is the khabar (predicate) of «إن». «ما» is maṣdar-forming, and the maṣdar (بنسيانهم) is attached to a second naʿt of «عذاب».

harrat-mujtaba:27-27.t: The clause «وما خلقنا» is resumptive. «باطلا»: a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), its adjective having taken its place, i.e.: a vain creating. The clause «ذلك ظن» is resumptive, and the clause «فويل للذين» is conjoined to the clause «ذلك ظن»; beginning with the indefinite noun «ويل» is permitted because it denotes a supplication. The preposition «من النار» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the [notion of] being established (al-istiqrār) to which the khabar (predicate) is attached.

harrat-mujtaba:28-28.t: «أم» is the disjoined (munqaṭiʿa) one, for turning away (iḍrāb). The clause «نجعل» is resumptive. The preposition «كالمفسدين» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the second object of «نجعل»; and the parsing of what follows it is likewise.

harrat-mujtaba:29-29.t: «كتاب»: khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e.: this. The clause «أنزلناه» is a naʿt (adjective) of «كتاب». The interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) «ليدبَّروا» is genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «أنزلناه». «مبارك» is a naʿt of «كتاب»; a non-explicit adjective [i.e. a clause] may come before an explicit one.

harrat-mujtaba:30-30.t: The clause «ووهبنا» is resumptive. The one specified for praise (al-makhṣūṣ bi-l-madḥ) is omitted, i.e.: Sulaymān. The clause «نعم العبد» is resumptive, and the clause «إنه أواب» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «العبد».

harrat-mujtaba:31-31.t: «إذ»: an adverbial noun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb whose implied form is «اذكر» ("remember"). «الصافنات»: nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), and «الجياد» is ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition). The clause «عُرض» is muḍāf ilayhi (in genitive construct).

harrat-mujtaba:32-32.t: The clause «فقال» is conjoined to the clause {عُرِضَ}. «حُبَّ»: a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). The preposition «عن ذكر» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the tāʾ in «أحببت», meaning: distracted from remembrance. The fāʿil (agent) of «توارت» is the pronoun of the sun, and the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) (أن توارت) is genitive, attached to «أحببت».

harrat-mujtaba:33-33.t: The clause «رُدُّوها» is resumptive within the scope of the speech. The clause «فطفق» is conjoined to an implied resumptive [clause], i.e.: so they returned them, and he began. «مسحا»: mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb, i.e.: stroking a stroking (يمسح مسحا); assuming the verb is necessary because the khabar (predicate) of «طفق» can only be an imperfect verb. The preposition «بالسوق» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the implied verb.

harrat-mujtaba:34-34.t: The clause «ولقد فتنَّا سليمان» is resumptive, and «جسدا» is the object of «ألقينا».

harrat-mujtaba:35-35.t: The clause «قال» is resumptive. The clause «لا ينبغي» is a naʿt (adjective) of «مُلكا». The clause «إنك أنت الوهاب» is resumptive; «أنت» is tawkīd (emphasis) of the kāf.

harrat-mujtaba:36-36.t: The clause «فسخَّرنا» is conjoined to the clause {قَالَ} in the preceding verse. The clause «تجري» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «الريح». The preposition «بأمره» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl from the fāʿil (agent) of «تجري». «رخاء»: ḥāl from «الريح». «حيث»: an adverb of place attached to «تجري», and the clause «أصاب» is muḍāf ilayhi (in genitive construct).

harrat-mujtaba:37-37.t: His words «والشياطين»: a noun conjoined to {الرِّيحَ}. «كل»: badal (substitute) of «الشياطين»; the intensive form was used because it is in the context of conferring favour.

harrat-mujtaba:38-38.t: His words «وآخرين»: conjoined to {كُلَّ}, so it falls under the ruling of the badal (substitute). «مقرنين»: naʿt (adjective). The preposition «في الأصفاد» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «مقرنين».

harrat-mujtaba:39-39.t: The clause «فامنن» is conjoined to the clause «هذا عطاؤنا». The preposition «بغير حساب» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil (agent) of the two verbs «امنن أو أمسك».

harrat-mujtaba:40-40.t: The clause «وإن له عندنا لزلفى» is a ḥāl (circumstantial). «عندنا»: an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) the [notion of] being established (al-istiqrār) to which the khabar (predicate) is attached.

harrat-mujtaba:41-41.t: The clause «واذكر» is resumptive. «أيوب»: badal (substitute). «إذ»: a badal of inclusion (badal ishtimāl) from «أيوب». The interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) formed from «أن» and what follows it is accusative by removal of the preposition (the bāʾ). The preposition «بنصب» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «مسَّني».

harrat-mujtaba:42-42.t: The preposition «برجلك» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «اركض». The clause «اركض برجلك» is the content of what is said (maqūl al-qawl) of an implied, resumptive speech, i.e.: We said. The clause «هذا مغتسل» is resumptive within the scope of the implied speech.

harrat-mujtaba:43-43.t: The clause «ووهبنا» is resumptive. «معهم»: an adverb of place attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «مثلهم». «رحمة»: mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), and the preposition «منا» is attached to a naʿt (adjective) of «رحمة». The preposition «لأولي» is attached to a naʿt of «ذكرى».

harrat-mujtaba:44-44.t: The clause (وقلنا له) «خذ» is conjoined to the clause «وهبنا», and the clause «خذ» is the content of what is said (maqūl al-qawl) of the implied [speech]. The clause «إنَّا وجدناه» is resumptive, and «صابرا» is a second object. The clause «نعم العبد» is resumptive, the clause «إنه أواب» is a ḥāl (circumstantial), and the one specified for praise (al-makhṣūṣ bi-l-madḥ) is omitted.

harrat-mujtaba:45-45.t: The clause «واذكر» is resumptive. «إبراهيم»: badal (substitute). «أولي»: naʿt (adjective) of those mentioned before.

harrat-mujtaba:47-47.t: The clause «وإنهم عندنا لمن المصطفين» is conjoined to the clause {إِنَّا أَخْلَصْنَاهُمْ}. The adverb «عندنا» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «المُصْطَفَيْن». «الأخيار»: naʿt (adjective).

harrat-mujtaba:48-48.t: The clause «واذكر» is resumptive. The clause «وكل من الأخيار» is conjoined to the clause «اذكر»; beginning with the indefinite noun «كل» is permitted because it denotes generality.

harrat-mujtaba:49-49.t: The clause «وإن للمتقين لحسن مآب» is resumptive. The preposition «للمتقين» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate) of «إن».

harrat-mujtaba:50-50.t: «جنات»: badal (substitute) of «حُسْن». «مفتحة»: ḥāl (circumstantial) from «جنات»; the preposition «لهم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «مفتحة»; «الأبواب» is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) of «مفتحة», which is a passive participle.

harrat-mujtaba:51-51.t: «متكئين»: ḥāl (circumstantial) from the pronoun in {لَهُمُ}; the preposition «فيها» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «متكئين». The clause «يدعون» is a second ḥāl from the pronoun in {لَهُمُ}.

harrat-mujtaba:52-52.t: The clause «وعندهم قاصرات» is conjoined to the clause {يَدْعُونَ}. «أتراب»: badal (substitute).

harrat-mujtaba:53-53.t: The clause «هذا ما توعدون» is the content of what is said (maqūl al-qawl) of an implied speech. The preposition «ليوم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «توعدون».

harrat-mujtaba:54-54.t: The clause «ما له من نفاد» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «رزقنا»; «نفاد» is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and «من» is redundant (zāʾida).

harrat-mujtaba:55-55.t: «هذا»: mubtadaʾ (subject) whose khabar (predicate) is omitted, i.e.: [is] for the believers. The clause «وإن للطاغين ...» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:56-56.t: «جهنم»: badal (substitute). The clause «يصلونها» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «جهنم». The clause «فبئس المهاد» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:57-57.t: «هذا»: mubtadaʾ (subject), whose khabar (predicate) is «حميم». The clause «فليذوقوه» is parenthetical; the fāʾ is parenthetical, and the lām is of command.

harrat-mujtaba:58-58.t: «وآخر»: the wāw is a conjunction, «آخر» is a mubtadaʾ (subject). The preposition «من شكله» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «آخر». «أزواج» is the khabar (predicate) of «آخر».

harrat-mujtaba:59-59.t: «مقتحم»: naʿt (adjective) of «فوج», and the object of «مقتحم» is implied, i.e.: the Fire. «معكم»: an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) a second naʿt of «فوج». «لا» is negating. «مرحبا»: mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb, i.e.: may the earth not be spacious for you with spaciousness, nor be wide. The preposition «بهم» is attached to «مرحبا». The clause «إنهم صالو» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:60-60.t: The content of what is said (maqūl al-qawl) is implied, i.e.: do not say that. «أنتم»: mubtadaʾ (subject) whose khabar (predicate) is omitted, i.e.: you [are those] to whom it is said: no welcome. The wāw in «قدَّمتموه» is for lengthening (ishbāʿ). The clause «فبئس القرار» is resumptive, and the one specified [for blame] is omitted, i.e.: Hell. The clause «لا مرحبا بكم» is the content of what is said of the implied speech.

harrat-mujtaba:61-61.t: The conditional clause is the response to the vocative, resumptive. «عذابا»: second object; «ضعفا»: naʿt (adjective). The preposition «في النار» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «زده».

harrat-mujtaba:62-62.t: The clause «وقالوا» is conjoined to {قَالُوا} in the preceding verse. «ما»: an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject); the preposition «لنا» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate). The clause «لا نرى» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the pronoun in «لنا». The clause «كنا» is a naʿt (adjective) of «رجالا». The preposition «من الأشرار» is attached to the second object.

harrat-mujtaba:63-63.t: The clause «أأتخذناهم» is resumptive within the scope of the speech; «سخريا» is a second object. The clause «زاغت» is conjoined to the clause «أتخذناهم».

harrat-mujtaba:65-65.t: «إله»: mubtadaʾ (subject), and «من» is redundant (zāʾida); «إلا» is for restriction. «الله»: badal (substitute) of the latent (mustatir) pronoun in the omitted khabar (predicate), whose implied form is: there is no god deserving of worship. «الواحد القهار»: two naʿts (adjectives). The clause «ما من إله إلا الله» is conjoined to the content of what is said (maqūl al-qawl).

harrat-mujtaba:66-66.t: «رب»: a third naʿt (adjective). «ما»: a relative noun conjoined to «السماوات». «العزيز الغفار»: two naʿts.

harrat-mujtaba:68-68.t: The preposition «عنه» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «معرضون», and the clause is a second naʿt (adjective) of {نَبَأٌ}.

harrat-mujtaba:69-69.t: «عِلم»: the noun of «كان», and «من» is redundant (zāʾida). The preposition «بالملإ» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the maṣdar (verbal noun) «علم». «إذ»: an adverb attached to «علم», and the clause «يختصمون» is muḍāf ilayhi (in genitive construct).

harrat-mujtaba:70-70.t: «إنْ» is negating, and the clause «إن يوحى» is resumptive. The maṣdar (verbal noun) formed from «أنّ» and what follows it is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) of «يوحى».

harrat-mujtaba:71-71.t: «إذ»: badal (substitute) of the preceding «إذ». «بشرا»: the object of «خالق». The preposition «من طين» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «بشرا».

harrat-mujtaba:72-72.t: The conditional clause is conjoined to the content of what is said (maqūl al-qawl). The clause «سوَّيته» is muḍāf ilayhi (in genitive construct). The clause «فقعوا» is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). «ساجدين»: ḥāl (circumstantial) from the wāw.

harrat-mujtaba:73-73.t: The clause «فسجد» is resumptive. «أجمعون»: a second tawkīd (emphasis), nominative with the wāw.

harrat-mujtaba:75-75.t: «ما»: an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject). The maṣdar (verbal noun) «أن تسجد» is accusative by removal of the preposition. The preposition «بيدي» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil (agent) of «خلقت». The clause «أستكبرت» is resumptive within the scope of the speech, and the clause «كنت» is conjoined to the clause «أستكبرت».

harrat-mujtaba:76-76.t: The preposition «منه» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «خير». The clause «خلقتني» is resumptive within the scope of the speech.

harrat-mujtaba:77-77.t: (قال فاخرج منها فإنك رجيم) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The content of what is said (maqūl al-qawl) is implied, and the fāʾ occurs in the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied condition, i.e.: if you refuse to prostrate, then get out. The clause «فإنك رجيم» is conjoined to the clause «اخرج».

harrat-mujtaba:78-78.t: The clause «وإنَّ عليك لعنتي» is conjoined to the clause «إنك رجيم». The preposition «إلى يوم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «لعنتي».

harrat-mujtaba:79-79.t: (قال رب فأنظرني إلى يوم يبعثون) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The fāʾ connects the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied condition, i.e.: if You have made me accursed, then grant me respite. The conditional clause is the content of what is said (maqūl al-qawl), and the clause «يبعثون» is muḍāf ilayhi (in genitive construct).

harrat-mujtaba:80-80.t: (قال فإنك من المنظرين) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The fāʾ connects the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied condition, i.e.: if you desire that, then you are...

harrat-mujtaba:81-81.t: The preposition «إلى يوم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) {الْمُنْظَرِينَ}.

harrat-mujtaba:82-82.t: (قال فبعزتك لأغوينهم أجمعين) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The fāʾ connects the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied condition, i.e.: if You grant me respite, then I swear. The preposition is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the implied «أقسم», and the clause «أقسم» is the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being «أنا». «أجمعين» is tawkīd (emphasis) of the hāʾ.

harrat-mujtaba:83-83.t: «عبادك»: excepted. The preposition «منهم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «المخلصين», and «المخلصين» is a naʿt (adjective).

harrat-mujtaba:84-84.t: (قال فالحق والحق أقول) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The fāʾ connects the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied condition, i.e.: if they are led astray by you, then the truth... «الحق» is a mubtadaʾ (subject) whose khabar (predicate) is the following oath clause together with its response. The clause «والحق أقول» is parenthetical between the mubtadaʾ and its khabar; «الحق» is the object of «أقول», and the wāw is parenthetical.

harrat-mujtaba:85-85.t: The clause «لأملأن» is the answer to the oath. The preposition «منك» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «أملأن», and the preposition «منهم» is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «مَنْ». «أجمعين» is tawkīd (emphasis) of the hāʾ in «منهم».

harrat-mujtaba:86-86.t: «أجر»: second object, and «مِن» is redundant (zāʾida). The negative clause is conjoined to the content of what is said (maqūl al-qawl), and «ما» acts like «ليس».

harrat-mujtaba:87-87.t: (إن هو إلا ذكر للعالمين) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] «إنْ» is negating, and «هو» is a mubtadaʾ (subject).

harrat-mujtaba:88-88.t: (ولتعلمن نبأه بعد حين) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The clause of the oath and the answer to the oath is conjoined to the clause {إِنْ هُوَ إِلا ذِكْرٌ}. [The verb is] an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, which was dropped because of the succession of identical [letters], and the wāw, dropped because of the meeting of two quiescent letters, is the fāʿil (agent). «بعد»: an adverb of time attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb.
